notes.subject: maina a diaparo
notes.rationale: Hoshene · Efode · Me'ile · Kutonete · Mitnephete · Abenete — maina a Seheberu a a dirilwego ka modumo, ka gobane ga a na mantšu a se nago a mafelelo a Sepedi

notes.subject: חשן
notes.rationale: 'Hoshene' — e ka bo e le 'sehlwana' (pocket) goba 'se seng mafeela' (rich); maemo a a hlakanogile ga a ka ka fetolelwa

notes.subject: go šomele ⟨go⟩
notes.rationale: לכהנו לי — infinitive construct; Sepedi e nyaka go oketša 'go' go hlaloša modumo

notes.subject: lenaneo la diaparo tše thataro
notes.rationale: temana e baakanya karolo ya diaparo tše thataro tša moperisita ka tatelano ya go baakanya

translation: Gomme se ke diaparo tšeo ba tla di dirago: Hoshene, le Efode, le Me'ile, le Kutonete ya go boaboa, le sekgarebana sa go phutha hlogwana, le lesela la go ikokoretša; gomme ba tla dira diaparo tša bokgethwa bakeng sa Aharone, mmaeṱhane wa gago, le bana ba gagwe, gore a šomele ⟨⟨go⟩⟩ nna bjalo ka moperisita.
